Also identified that apply_sub_sustain_controller runs pre-make-up-gain (x0=0.65).

Fourier of Longing - Equalizer settled at -0.98 dBTP (+0.02 dB) because limit() uses sample peaks while outer loop scales effective_ceiling via 4x oversampled true_peak(), and post-loop exact true-peak trim is gated behind controls.max_limiter_gr_db.is_some().
